items.briefing:
Australian organisations are facing growing financial pressure from cyber incidents, with IBM reporting the average data breach now costs AUD $4.22 million locally. Separately, Sharesight has warned investors not to rely on AI tools for tax calculations, as errors could lead to compliance issues — a timely reminder that AI-generated advice should always be verified by a qualified professional.

On a practical note, KnowBe4 has launched voice-call phishing ("vishing") simulations to help train staff against phone-based scams, which are increasingly common. **Tip:** If you receive an unexpected call asking for login credentials or personal details — even from someone claiming to be IT support — hang up and verify through official channels before sharing anything.

featured.title: Australia breach costs hit AUD $4.22 million, IBM says
featured.quote: Data breach costs in Australia are rising significantly as AI-generated attacks become more sophisticated and costly.
